description.cmn_hans_cn: 获取基金经理的基础信息。可按基金经理代码批量查询，返回基金经理姓名、出生年份、简历、基金经理代码、性别等数据。当用户想了解某公募基金经理的基本背景、从业年限时，调用此接口。
description.en: Obtain basic information for fund managers. Supports batch query by fund manager codes, returning fields such as fund manager name, birth year, resume, fund manager code, and gender. Call this interface when users want to understand the basic background or industry experience of a fund manager.
